baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated رَبُّ separately governs the dual nouns ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ and ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rising and setting are opposed phases of one ordered horizon cycle; repeating the same governor over both prevents either phase from becoming autonomous.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority make the repeated title a single jurisdiction distributed over both poles.
Rising light supplies the cycle's emergence pole and the literal horizon anchor.
Sunset, west, and plural settings supply the recession pole and authorize more than one setting station.

changed_reading.before: A title naming ownership of two eastern and two western places.
changed_reading.after: A compact account of one authority governing paired, recurrent transitions into and out of visibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of رَبُّ frame both the rising and the receding terms as objects of ongoing care.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lordly relation can be processive: emergence is brought along and recession is carried through, so both halves belong to stage-by-stage formation rather than bare possession.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion turn lordship into active administration of each transition.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nurture and growing up reinforces a developmental, not merely territorial, relation.
Rising light provides the coming-forth phase that care brings to manifestation.
Distance and moving away make setting a managed departure rather than a mere opposite location.

changed_reading.before: The verse assigns two directional regions to a sovereign.
changed_reading.after: The verse names care over the full life of a manifestation: its rise, development, departure, and distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ and ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ can be read as paired limits of exposure, while رَبُّ is repeated at both limits.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sun-facing zone and an extreme edge define a field from maximal disclosure to terminal recession; lasting governance holds while the visible boundary migrates.

activation_trace.role: Staying, clinging, and lasting supply continuity across mobile horizon limits.
The sun-facing place supplies a zone of exposure rather than only a compass direction.
Edge, sharpness, and extremity make the western term function as a terminal boundary.

changed_reading.before: Two east points are paired with two west points.
changed_reading.after: The pair spans a changing field of exposure from luminous presentation to its furthest edge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun and moon under calculation make the dual horizon nouns measurable stations generated by recurrent motion, strengthening the baseline cycle over a static map.

activation_trace.role: Authority joins both horizon clauses under one ordering power.
Rising light supplies the variable emergence stations to be calculated.
Plural settings and seasonal settings supply corresponding recession stations.
The sun supplies the moving luminous body whose rise and set produce horizon positions.
The moon and its light add a second recurrent body, resisting a sun-only reading of the duals.
Counting and calculation convert recurrence into calibrated order rather than loose repetition.

structural_cues: 55:5 places two luminaries under reckoning before 55:17 names both rising and setting termini in the dual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two luminaries, calculation, and dual horizon terms; I infer that counted motion generates multiple stations. A live alternative is that the duals denote two distinct domains without a temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A general sovereignty formula over opposed directions.
changed_reading.after: Sovereignty over the calculated variation of where luminous bodies enter and leave the visible field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The horizon pair becomes a cosmic measuring span: its opposed termini establish calibrated difference, while the ban on crossing a limit gives the spatial order an ethical analogue.

activation_trace.role: Authority makes both extrema answer to the same norm rather than compete.
Rising light supplies one observable endpoint of the calibrated span.
Edge and extremity supply the opposite limit against which the span is held.
Balancing and aligning two things turns the two horizon sides into a relational measure.
Crossing a limit in transgression supplies the prohibited failure mode of that measured relation.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeats the balance and moves from cosmic placement to commands against excess and loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired horizons, alignment, and prohibited limit-crossing; I infer an analogy between cosmic extrema and disciplined measure. The live alternative is that balance language governs commerce only and does not modify the horizons.

changed_reading.before: The duals mark recurrent astronomical stations.
changed_reading.after: The duals also model ordered difference: distinct limits held in relation without excess, collapse, or loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two seas meet, remain connected through an interval, do not overrun one another, and yield something from both. This activates the two risings and two settings as maintained interfaces whose difference is productive, not merely oppositional.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion make boundary maintenance an active enabling relation.
Rising light supplies one side's emergence through the interface.
Setting supplies the differentiated counter-movement without erasing the pair.
Two opposed things coming together supplies contact without prior identity.
A connection standing between endpoints makes the middle relational rather than empty.
Overstepping a limit by aggression supplies the blocked merger that preserves productive difference.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the yield enabled by the maintained relation.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 repeats dual morphology and dual pronouns around meeting, a barrier, non-transgression, and emergence from both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a paired meeting, a maintained interval, non-overrun, and shared yield; I transfer that relational pattern to the focus duals. A live alternative is that the maritime sequence is local imagery with no horizon-level mechanism.

changed_reading.before: East and west are terminal opposites under one ruler.
changed_reading.after: Each rising-setting pair is a governed interface where contact and separation cooperate to make emergence possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rise-set cycle becomes an enacted contrast between appearances that depart and the governing presence that remains; repetition of رَبُّ across both phases marks continuity beneath turnover.

activation_trace.role: Staying and lasting supply continuity across both clauses.
Rising light supplies appearance and arrival within the transient cycle.
Setting supplies departure and loss from the visible field.
Cessation and going after persistence generalize setting into creaturely finitude.
Duration and remaining supply the countercondition that survives every recession.
Face as self or presence identifies what remains as the governing source, not another transient object.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 places universal passing and remaining presence in immediate contrast after the horizon cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rising, setting, cessation, and remaining; I infer that the astronomical alternation figures a broader asymmetry between transient manifestation and abiding governance. The live alternative keeps the horizon statement purely cosmographic.

changed_reading.before: A recurrent cycle whose two phases are equally described.
changed_reading.after: A recurrent lesson in finitude: appearances rise and withdraw while the authority sustaining both does not enter their disappearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Requests, temporal recurrence, and ongoing repair turn lordship of the horizons into responsive administration renewed at each interval.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion supply the active content of lordship.
Rising light supplies one repeatedly renewed state.
Setting supplies its repeatedly administered transition away.
Question and request supply the demands to which ongoing administration responds.
A duration of time supplies recurrence without forcing a strictly twenty-four-hour scale.
Repairing and doing work well supplies a concrete mode for the renewed affair.

structural_cues: 55:29 combines universal asking with كُلَّ يَوْمٍ and an ongoing affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring time, requests, and an affair whose branch can be repaired well; I infer responsive governance at each horizon transition. A live alternative reads 'day' as any period and the affair as unrelated to astronomical recurrence.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the owner of a stable cosmic cycle.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies the administrator who continually renews, answers within, and carries each phase of that cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The horizon extrema become jurisdictional limits rather than decorative edges: crossing from one side to another is imaginable, but passage depends on effective authority.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and authority turn the horizon pair into a jurisdiction.
A sun-facing place supplies a located side from which passage might begin.
Edge and extremity supply the apparent outer limit to be crossed.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the traversal mechanism.
Sides and regions expand the horizon points into the circumference of a domain.
Power and delegated authority supply the condition under which traversal can succeed.

structural_cues: 55:33 directly challenges both addressed kinds to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and earth, then conditions passage on authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domain sides, other-side passage, and authority; I infer that the focus horizons mark governed limits whose crossing is conditional. A live alternative is a rhetorical impossibility rather than a map of traversable thresholds.

changed_reading.before: The horizons are outer coordinates possessed by the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The horizons are controlled thresholds: apparent exits remain inside a jurisdiction, and crossing requires conferred power.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the sky itself can split and enter a new state, east-west coordinates cease to be an ultimate fixed frame. Lordship extends to changing the medium that makes horizons possible.

activation_trace.role: Authority over both horizons extends naturally to the frame containing them.
Rising light identifies one event dependent on an intact visible sky.
Edge and extreme identify the other event as a boundary produced by that frame.
Splitting and opening make the horizon-bearing sky structurally discontinuous.
Occurrence and presence in time supply a state transition for the sky rather than a timeless description.

structural_cues: 55:37 presents the sky splitting and becoming red like an oily surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split sky and temporal becoming; I infer that the coordinate frame generating east and west is contingent and governable. A live alternative confines the scene to a future spectacle without revising 55:17's present cosmography.

changed_reading.before: The verse locates authority within a stable east-west cosmic frame.
changed_reading.after: The verse places even the production, stability, and transformation of that coordinate frame under authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later pairs of flowing springs, paired fruits, and another pair of gardens turn duality into a repeated architecture of differentiated provision. The horizon duals can therefore organize abundance rather than merely divide space.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion connect paired structure with provision and maturation.
Rising light supplies emergence as one productive half of the pattern.
Setting supplies differentiated counter-rhythm rather than cancellation.
Flow and coursing make the paired springs active channels rather than duplicate objects.
A source of running water gives each member of the dual a generative outlet.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart makes pairing a relation that preserves two members.
Nearness short of an endpoint supplies a second tier without collapsing it into the first pair.
Abundant gushing water intensifies the productive output of the second paired sources.

structural_cues: 55:46, 55:50, 55:52, 55:62, and 55:66 repeatedly deploy dual forms in nested scenes of gardens, springs, and fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated paired containers, sources, flows, and fruits; I infer a surah-level architecture in which maintained difference multiplies provision. A live alternative treats each dual as local description without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The two risings and settings divide the world into opposite sides.
changed_reading.after: The paired horizons inaugurate a reusable form of abundance: distinct counterparts, each governed and each able to yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant ear-splitting branch of ش ر ق alongside later sky-opening and passage imagery. It remains anchored to ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ and the edge sense of ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ are imagined as openings and the two ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ as their terminal edges.

activation_trace.role: Splitting an ear open contributes the concrete aperture image and functions as an exploratory model of a horizon opening.
Edge and extremity keep the aperture model attached to the focus's opposite terminal boundary.
An unobstructed passage supplies the functional consequence of an opening.
Splitting and opening the sky scales the small material cut into a cosmic aperture.

changed_reading.before: Horizons are points at which light appears and disappears.
changed_reading.after: Horizons may be imagined as governed apertures in the visible frame, opening emergence and closing it at an edge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines collected water under ر ب ب and the bucket sense of غ ر ب with later paired waters. The focus roots and dual structure keep it traceable, while the sea and spring sequence makes the material analogy coherent; downstream prose must label it an exploratory circulation model, not claim that رَبُّ or مَغْرِب literally means reservoir or bucket here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated رَبُّ and paired rising-setting terms are recast as two-sided collection, release, and return.

activation_trace.role: Abundant collected water supplies a reservoir image and makes repeated governance a holding function.
Rising supplies the release or emergence phase of the circulation analogy.
The large bucket and water carrier supply collection and transfer at the recession side.
Vast abundant water enlarges the focus analogy into a paired hydrological domain.
A running-water source supplies a concrete outlet within the paired domain.
Flow and coursing provide the directional transfer linking collection and release.

changed_reading.before: The verse governs a visual cycle across the sky.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it can model a two-sided circulation in which what emerges, flows, recedes, and is gathered remains under one care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the axial-rotation branch comes from the form-distant ح و ر cue at 55:72. It remains valid as an abductive geometry because rotation naturally generates recurrent rising and setting extrema already anchored in both focus nouns; downstream prose should call it a branch-triggered model, not a translation of حُورٌ or proof of a particular cosmology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ and ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ are treated as extrema generated by return around an axis.

activation_trace.role: Repeated rising of luminous bodies supplies one observable extreme of rotation.
Repeated and seasonal settings supply the opposite observable extreme.
Rotation around an axis supplies the hidden motion capable of generating both paired extrema.

changed_reading.before: The verse names four fixed horizon locations.
changed_reading.after: The four terms can be carried as extrema generated by recurrent axial motion, with governance applying to the generating motion as well as its visible endpoints.

strongest_changes: The calculated sun-moon cue turns the dual horizons from fixed places into recurrent, measurable stations.
The two-sea sequence turns opposition into a bounded, productive interface where contact and non-overrun coexist.
Finitude and remaining presence make the rise-set cycle an asymmetrical lesson in transient manifestation and abiding governance.
Later paired springs, fruits, and gardens make duality a repeated architecture of differentiated provision.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated رَبُّ did more than unify opposite directions: dominant nurture branches, the non-dominant growth mapping, and later dual structures activated temporal, ethical, jurisdictional, generative, and ontological readings at once. Aperture, hydraulic, and axial models remain explicitly contained rather than being flattened out.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not decide whether the duals primarily mark seasonal extrema, multiple luminaries, two domains, or rhetorical plenitude.
The transfers from balance, seas, cosmic rupture, and garden pairs are reader-supplied relational arrows; each source sequence can remain local.
The root_000537 growth activation and all three outliers are structurally productive but too branch-distant to render as direct lexical meanings.
